- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.3) — reduce forecast by 1–2% relative to sentiment peak.
- Underestimate during strong negative sentiment (sentiment < 0.1) — add 0.5–1.5% to forecast to avoid underreaction.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below peak observed in 3–5 prior days.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is > 20% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10–15%.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment peaks 2–3 days prior, adjust forecast downward by 0.5–1.0% to account for delayed reaction.
- Horizon-specific: for 30-day forecasts, avoid overconfidence in early days — reduce first 5 days’ forecast by 0.5–1.0% if sentiment is rising.
